categories.main_business_segments: PetroChina operates primarily in five segments: Oil, Gas and New Energy; Refining, Chemicals and New Materials; Marketing; Natural Gas Sales; and Head Office and Other. The company engages in exploration, development, production, transportation, and marketing of crude oil and natural gas, refining of crude oil and petroleum products, production and marketing of petrochemical products and new materials, marketing of refined and non-oil products, trading, and natural gas transportation and sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced exploration and development technologies for oil and gas, including high-efficient exploration and high-profitable development, shale oil and shale gas development, and carbon capture, utilization and storage (CCUS). Refining and chemical production involve transformation and upgrading projects focusing on high value-added and featured products. The company also invests in new energy technologies such as wind, photovoltaic power generation, geothermal energy, hydrogen energy, and biofuel industries.
categories.primary_customers_markets: PetroChina serves a broad customer base including domestic and international markets for crude oil, natural gas, refined oil products, petrochemicals, and new materials. Its customers include industrial enterprises, direct sales customers, industrial customers, and end-users in energy, chemical, and related sectors. The company also operates comprehensive energy service stations and supplies natural gas to urban and industrial markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China’s mainland and overseas regions including the Middle East, Central Asia, Africa, Americas, Asia-Pacific, and specific countries such as Kazakhstan, Oman, Suriname, Iraq, Indonesia, Chad, and others. It holds exploration and production rights over 236.7 million acres globally, with significant assets and operations both domestically and internationally.
categories.supply_chain_position: PetroChina operates across the entire oil and gas supply chain, including upstream exploration and production, midstream transportation and storage, and downstream refining, chemicals production, marketing, and sales. It also engages in new energy generation and integrated energy services, positioning itself as a fully integrated energy company.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation and R&D with a focus on increasing reserves and production efficiency, refining and chemical business transformation, and new energy development. R&D investments target high-end olefins, special rubber, frontier materials, biofuels, and carbon capture technologies. The company emphasizes green and low-carbon transformation, digital transformation, and development of new materials and energy sources such as wind, solar, geothermal, hydrogen, and CCUS.
categories.revenue_model: PetroChina generates revenue primarily through the sale of crude oil, natural gas, refined oil products, petrochemical products, and new materials. It also earns income from marketing and trading activities, natural gas sales, and integrated energy services. Revenue streams include product sales, trading margins, and service fees across its diversified energy portfolio.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: As the largest oil and gas producer and seller in China and one of the largest globally, PetroChina holds a leading market position. It competes with other major integrated oil companies domestically and internationally, including Sinopec and CNOOC in China, and global oil majors. The company leverages its scale, integrated operations, and strategic investments in new energy to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, PetroChina reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.94 trillion with a net profit attributable to owners of RMB 164.7 billion, showing a slight revenue decrease but profit growth compared to the previous year. Total assets were about RMB 2.75 trillion with equity of RMB 1.52 trillion. The company’s capital expenditures were RMB 275.8 billion, reflecting stable investment levels. It maintains a strong financial position with a gearing ratio of 12.2% and continues to grow production outputs and reserves steadily.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: PetroChina emphasizes reliable energy supply, green development, and high-quality products. It differentiates through integrated operations spanning upstream to downstream, advanced technology adoption, and a diversified energy portfolio including new energy sources. The company focuses on producing high value-added and featured refined and chemical products, expanding new materials, and providing comprehensive energy services to meet evolving market demands and sustainability goals.
